column_description: Unique identifier for each rendering log.
ID of the rendering configuration used. may be NULL.
ID of the scene that was rendered. may be NULL.
Number of objects in the scene. may be NULL.
Number of materials used in the scene. may be NULL.
Number of lighting configurations used in the scene. may be NULL.
ID of the camera used for rendering. may be NULL.
Start time of the rendering process. may be NULL.
End time of the rendering process. may be NULL.
Performance data (e.g., rendering time, memory usage). always exactly one of 'rendering time', 'memory usage'. may be NULL.
Detailed performance metrics (e.g., rendering time, memory usage, CPU/GPU usage). always exactly one of 'rendering time', 'memory usage', 'CPU/GPU usage'. may be NULL.
